correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts generic continuous piecewise-affine centre/order/clip chambers. Row expressions remain valid even if central order statistics are clipped. Single-step decomposition gives the exact induced path-variation norm. The separated-versus-coincident median cut cases bound every chamber by the stated branches, and strict realising chambers attain each branch. Finite exact mask enumerations, rational witnesses, and independent input-pair checks corroborate; they are not used to infer the infinite all-n statement.

value.rationale: Global robust clipping around the sample median is a natural preprocessing map, not an arbitrary finite slice. The result determines a complete sharp, attained stability coefficient in all dimensions for both odd medians and the full range of even-sample central-rank conventions, shows a minimax parameter plateau, and quantifies why individual variation contraction does not imply perturbation contraction. It provides exact worst-case tests without claiming statistical-risk improvement.
